name: Gulumoerrgin/Larrakia seasonal knowledge calendar
description: A collaborative calendar presents Gulumoerrgin/Larrakia seasonal ecological knowledge and credits named community contributors.

date.basis: Date of the cited witness; not a claim of origin.

events.statement: The calendar acknowledges knowledge sourced from Larrakia and Limilngan elders in 1989–1994.

evidence.locator: Credits, acknowledgements, and Indigenous cultural and intellectual property notice
evidence.supports: The calendar names Gulumoerrgin/Larrakia contributors Lorraine Williams, Judith Williams, Maureen Ogden, Keith Risk and Anne Risk. It credits CSIRO science co-design in 2012 and knowledge sourced from Larrakia and Limilngan elders in 1989–1994. The notice reserves community ownership and control and restricts reproduction; this note records only attribution and dating metadata.

earliest_record.rationale: The 2012 co-design credit anchors the calendar collaboration; the earlier acknowledged sourcing concerns existing community knowledge.

caveats: The dated sourcing and later design do not establish when this knowledge originated. The calendar’s Indigenous cultural and intellectual property notice reserves community ownership and control; no calendar content is reproduced here.

research.note: Independent review checked only the publicly stated attribution, sourcing interval and co-design credit; no calendar ecological content is reproduced.
